name: Unfolding Wind Strike
prerequisites: Dex 13; Wis 13; Perfect Style; Quick Draw; base attack bonus +9 or monk level 9th
benefit:
When using Perfect Style, you double the range increment of any thrown weapon you wield. You can spend 1 ki point as a swift action to imbue a number of thrown weapons equal to your Wisdom bonus with the returning or seeking weapon special ability for 1 round.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Weapon Master's Handbook pg. 25
You can spend 2 stamina points instead of 1 ki point when using Unfolding Wind Strike.
flavor: The wind through which your thrown weapons fly directs them to their targets or back to your hand.
